experiments.title: Durable phases within one agent
experiments.book_concept: Chapters 1, 4, 5: planning, execution and review nodes
experiments.hypothesis: Phase checkpoints avoid repeating completed evidence acquisition without adding agent roles.
acceptance: Verified acquisition executes once after resume
Same owner and source identities survive
experiments.later_live_question: Does phase recovery reduce repeated live work without lowering answer quality?

experiments.title: Independent source-bound criticism
experiments.hypothesis: An independent critic catches consequential errors missed by the author and mechanical validation.
acceptance: Criticism binds an existing claim and source
Blinded review finds fewer material errors
rejection: More false objections than useful corrections
experiments.later_live_question: Does an independent critic improve held-out factual decisions at acceptable cost?

experiments.title: Complementary evidence investigators
experiments.book_concept: Chapters 6, 8: parallel investigation and evidence communication
experiments.hypothesis: Independent source scopes improve coverage and reveal contradictions without duplicated search.
acceptance: All surviving evidence retains source identity
experiments.later_live_question: Do complementary investigators improve coverage or latency under an equal aggregate allowance?

experiments.title: Supervisor-directed bounded repair
experiments.hypothesis: Source-bound repair instructions correct the actual deficit rather than repeating the whole workflow.
acceptance: Missing evidence produces a precise stop
experiments.later_live_question: Does targeted correction recover more valid answers per additional model request?

experiments.title: Minimum-sufficient context and history
experiments.book_concept: Chapters 2, 7, 9: context injection and progressive disclosure
experiments.hypothesis: One authoritative packet with equivalent history policy lowers context cost while preserving current intent.
acceptance: Every unique source and latest instruction retained
experiments.later_live_question: Do deduplicated packets preserve decisions and reduce tokens on held-out continuations?

experiments.title: Isolated checkpoint inspection and forks
experiments.hypothesis: Read-only checkpoint inspection and isolated forks make failures reproducible without replaying effects.
acceptance: Source execution and checkpoint are linked
Fork cannot inherit approvals or live capabilities
experiments.later_live_question: Does a controlled historical fork shorten diagnosis of a real failure?

experiments.title: Document text versus text plus selected page images
experiments.book_concept: Chapters 2, 5, 13: preserving decisive document layout evidence
experiments.hypothesis: A selected page image recovers a decisive table cell absent from extracted text, without letting the model invent the missing value.
fault_cases: Decisive table cell missing from text extraction
Page bytes do not match manifest
Gold answer leaks into text-only prompt
acceptance: Both variants use the same document and extracted text
Image variant contains the exact verified page PNG
Paired model/human review assesses factual improvement
rejection: Text-only prompt includes hidden gold facts
Fixture result is generalized to untested documents
experiments.later_live_question: Does the selected page image correctly recover prospective-evaluation status that the extracted text cannot establish?

cases.request: Assess whether the supplied digital-health pilot supports a partnership recommendation. Distinguish feasibility from established efficacy; do not take any action.

sources.text: A synthetic company tested a workflow with 18 volunteers. The announcement reports acceptable usability and plans a larger study.
An independent synthetic review notes the uncontrolled pilot has no efficacy endpoint and cannot establish clinical benefit.

scripted_answer.recommendation: Consider further evidence review before recommending a partnership.
limitations: The study is small and uncontrolled.
scripted_answer.next_step: Request the study protocol for review.

obligations.description: Distinguish feasibility from established clinical efficacy.
Assess whether the supplied pilot supports a partnership recommendation.

cases.request: Explain whether these results justify routine deployment. Preserve the difference between retrospective performance and prospective clinical benefit.

sources.text: External reviewers describe a retrospective comparison with no prospective evaluation or patient-outcome measurement.
A synthetic vendor reports high retrospective accuracy on a selected dataset. Prospective evaluation is planned and not completed.

claims.text: Prospective patient benefits have been established.

scripted_answer.recommendation: Request prospective evaluation before routine deployment.

obligations.description: Distinguish retrospective performance from prospective clinical benefit.
Explain whether the results justify routine deployment.

July 8: the meeting is complete; the collaborator thanked the operator and invited future ideas.

claims.text: The latest message still requests scheduling availability.

cases.request: Use the newest correction: the review is tomorrow, not today. Return a short status and no external action.

sources.text: Earlier automated summary: review is today.
Newest human correction: review is tomorrow. The earlier date is wrong.

claims.text: The human correction moves the review to tomorrow.
The current review date is today.

scripted_answer.recommendation: Use tomorrow as the review date.
limitations: No calendar was read or changed.

obligations.description: Use the newest human correction instead of the obsolete date.
Return a short status without external action.
